column1: # slug -> canonical project key overrides for ai-sync-memory.
# One "slug<TAB>project" per line. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Only needed when the default heuristic is wrong. The heuristic handles
# "...repos-<name>" (Windows C:/D: checkouts) and "-worksp-<name>" (Linux
# /worksp checkouts) automatically; everything else needs a line here.
# WHY THIS MATTERS (found 2026-07-26): a slug that does not normalise gets its
# own project key, so the same logical project silently stores memory in TWO
# places and neither machine ever sees the other's. 87 memory files sat stranded
# under "-worksp-*" keys and 17 more under "D--*"/"C--PopDAM-*"; `pull` reported
# them as ordinary "no local project dir on this machine yet" skips, which reads
# as normal. If you add a checkout on a NEW path shape, add its mapping here in
# the same commit.
C--repos-temp-1Password-MCP
# Windows checkouts not under a directory called "repos".
C--PopDAM-popdam3
D--openclaw
D--popdam-claude-supabase-mcp
D--synology-monitor
# Linux (hetz) sessions rooted at "/" and at "/worksp" itself. These are
# session-level memory rather than a single project's, so they keep their own
# keys instead of being folded into a project.
-worksp
